o: Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts are looking forward to carefree time in the majestic landscape of Camp Spring Lake. Along with Charlie Brown and the rest of the Peanuts gang, join Snoopy and the birds as they hike, swim and leap their way through another round of fun and adventure in the Great Outdoors! This summer at Camp Snoopy, search for the elusive hedge toad, build towering sandcastles and…

eps.t: Following in the Pawprints / Roughing It
eps.o: Snoopy looks to the famous First Beagle Scout to help motivate his lazy troop. Feeling like camp is too easy, Peppermint Patty tries roughing it.

eps.t: Big Fish Called Big Red / Listen Up, Kid
eps.o: A rainy day sets the scene for stories about legendary fish Big Red. The gang tries to cheer up an unhappy camper.
Charlie Brown realizes being the camp postmaster is no easy task. Naomi gets Snoopy hooked on the art of crafting.

eps.t: The King of the Sandcastle / A New Camp Record
eps.o: When Snoopy spends a day on shore, he takes up extreme sandcastle building. Peppermint Patty is determined to break a camp record.

eps.t: A Clubhouse Built for Two / A Camp Divided
eps.o: The discovery of a new clubhouse is a very hard secret to keep. Snoopy settles the great camp debate: hamburgers or hot dogs?
Snoopy wants to impress his brother, but his troop is in poor form. After a prank, Sally wants Charlie Brown and Snoopy to get even on her behalf.
Snoopy breaks a promise to his troop when he ditches them for a camp rodeo. Linus commits to proving the existence of a legendary critter.
Snoopy feels guilty after taking something that isn't his. Embarrassed by a mean nickname, Marcie asks Snoopy for help.
Charlie Brown tries to impress a nice girl from another camp. Lucy decides to be easygoing for once, but Snoopy's antics test her patience.

eps.t: Junior Counselor / Too Cool for Camp
eps.o: Charlie Brown becomes a junior counselor—and the camp stickler. Joe Cool makes an appearance at summer camp, but it isn't his scene.

eps.t: The Marshmallow Tree / The Balancing Rock
eps.o: When a scout disappears, Snoopy and the troop leave no stone unturned. The Beagle Scouts take on more than they can carry while trying to help.
Indecisive Charlie Brown decides to leave his fate to a paper fortune teller. Woodstock's new toy soon becomes a full-blown obsession.
Detective Snoopy and Charlie Brown must figure out why Sally's upset. It's time to fill up the camp memory book, and Lucy wants it to be perfect.
